## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A concurrency test with two workers claiming simultaneously never hands the...

The system SHALL ensure that a concurrency test with two workers claiming simultaneously never hands the same dispatch to both.

#### Scenario: A concurrency test with two workers claiming simultaneously never hands the...

WHEN `add-a-signed-coordinator-dispatch-queue-with-leases` is implemented
THEN A concurrency test with two workers claiming simultaneously never hands the same dispatch to both.

### Requirement: A concurrency test shows a lease that expires without a heartbeat returns...

The system SHALL ensure that a concurrency test shows a lease that expires without a heartbeat returns the dispatch to the queue and it is claimable again.

#### Scenario: A concurrency test shows a lease that expires without a heartbeat returns...

WHEN `add-a-signed-coordinator-dispatch-queue-with-leases` is implemented
THEN A concurrency test shows a lease that expires without a heartbeat returns the dispatch to the queue and it is claimable again.

### Requirement: Dispatch requests without a valid coordinator signature are rejected at...

The system SHALL ensure that dispatch requests without a valid coordinator signature are rejected at claim time.

#### Scenario: Dispatch requests without a valid coordinator signature are rejected at...

WHEN `add-a-signed-coordinator-dispatch-queue-with-leases` is implemented
THEN Dispatch requests without a valid coordinator signature are rejected at claim time.

### Requirement: Queue rows store dispatch requests and results that validate against the...

The system SHALL ensure that queue rows store dispatch requests and results that validate against the unmodified ri-21 schemas, and the ri-07 tracker adapter enqueues through the same API as any other producer.

#### Scenario: Queue rows store dispatch requests and results that validate against the...

WHEN `add-a-signed-coordinator-dispatch-queue-with-leases` is implemented
THEN Queue rows store dispatch requests and results that validate against the unmodified ri-21 schemas, and the ri-07 tracker adapter enqueues through the same API as any other producer.
